bootstrap: 2000 deterministic whole-block resamples; unresolved sustained crossings remain right-censored; medians use the ordinary empirical median with infinity for unresolved values, never substituted horizon counts.
by_construction:
**By construction** (report for scale only):
1. Conditional on law (b), the firings carry no set-point information: a reader whose law set is {b} has a firings-only set-point posterior equal to the prior. The registered reader marginalizes over four laws, so under truth (b) its firings-only posterior departs slightly from the prior (up to 0.08 at 256 records in the pre-check).
2. Choices carry the set points under every law, because the restoring rule depends on them, and they carry nothing about the law. Menus, stocks and choices have the same distribution under every law, so P2's choices-only recovery has the same expectation under all four laws.
3. (d) equals (b) whenever both deficits are equal, including whenever both needs are at or above their set points.
4. (a) and (c) are zero at or above the set point. (b), (c) and (d) sit at the 0.02 floor on any record without a fall.
5. The ceiling dominates the hidden-stock readers in expectation.
6. The arm's statistic under (b) is at most about 0 (items 1 and 2), so only its values under (a), (c) and (d) are informative.
interpretation: Constructed method; miniature, architecture untested; no human inference or confirmation.
intervals: Pointwise 95% Student-t intervals for block means; block-percentile intervals for medians, median differences/ratios, and conditional proportions. All bars use the complete interval. No simultaneous or confirmation claim.
modelling_choices: Provisional chronology: menus and restoring choices use start-of-record stocks; hidden decay/drop then restoring are applied together and clipped once; channels use the net start/end change. The ceiling sees both stocks and hidden outcomes. Exact joint 21x21 filtering uses uniform initial stocks and uniform law, set-point-pair and gain priors. Eight independently seeded makers per block per law in primary, four in texture. Case checks use 240 excluded worlds, best rival gain minimizes mean squared probability error within each maker; eligible records are counted per channel. Compilation uses the resident single-thread Numba stack, with all sources and dependencies pinned.
question: Can hidden-stock evidence distinguish direction-relative from need-balance-relative triggers, and locate set points?
routes: Sounding Line: a real-record trigger-law test needs dated context for stocks, losses and contacts, not cues alone.
ToMpathy: set-point marks require an explicit stock-observation and trigger model; this miniature does not license a display.
texture_practical_change_rule: One record for records-needed statistics; 0.05 for probability/log-score summaries. Unavailable comparisons cannot count as unchanged.
